TOPEKA (KSNT) – Members of the Kansas State Board of Education are set to vote on a proposed policy that addresses artificial intelligence, student technology access and more during their upcoming November meeting.

Officials with the Kansas State Department of Education (KSDE) announced in a press release the board will meet Monday and Tuesday, Nov. 9-10. The board will vote on a proposed policy about instructional technology in Kansas school districts and nonpublic accredited schools.
